component.name: Nodus Studio
component.summary: Desktop IoT and electronics simulation workbench

description.p: Nodus Studio is an open-source interactive electronics workbench and IoT simulation studio. It features an authoritative Rust simulation engine with cycle-accurate AVR emulation, deterministic scheduling, digital logic analyzer, and virtual MQTT IoT integration.
Initial release with interactive canvas, Lua sandboxing, Arduino Uno AVR emulator, virtual MQTT bridge, .nodus persistence, and digital logic analyzer.
